eps.o: Bobby Flay's Triple Threat Titans Michael Voltaggio and Brooke Williamson team up with heavy hitter chefs Adriana Urbina and Marcel Vigneron to conquer Bobby.
Carson Kressley and Maneet Chauhan bring the razzle dazzle as chefs Rajesh Pathak and Hideki Harada take on Bobby Flay with a challenging signature dish.
Josh Capon and Today's Dylan Dreyer fire up Bobby Flay's grill with pitmasters Matt Abdoo and Dominique Leach.
Jeff Mauro and comedian Chelsea Peretti bring Bobby Flay the laughs as they cheer on Italian chefs Antonio de Ieso and Ciro Fodera.
Legendary chefs Wolfgang Puck and protégé Antonia Lofaso team up with an incredible chef couple, Fany Gerson and Danny Ortiz de Montellano, to take on Bobby Flay.
Duff Goldman and Amanda Freitag attempt to bake up a win against Bobby Flay with pastry chefs Yohann Le Bescond and Andy de la Cruz.
Bobby Flay is way out of his element with a signature dish he's never made before. Damaris Phillips and Christian Petroni taunt him as chefs Ilji Cheung and Pyet Despain attempt to roll up a win.
Well, Heavens to Betsy! Jeff Mauro and Carson Kressley clutch their pearls as they cheer against Bobby Flay in favor of Southern chefs Alexia Gawlak and Austin Sumrall.
Bobby Flay gets shaken and stirred when Taraji P. Henson and Amanda Freitag try to mix up a defeat with pastry chefs Maurice Shelton and Cristina Vazquez.
Stage and screen actor Josh Gad duets with Damaris Phillips to turn out Bobby Flay's lights while preparing chefs Ciaran McGoldrick and Josh Mouzakes for their big debut.
Abbott Elementary's Quinta Brunson and Chef Michael Voltaggio try to give Bobby Flay detention with their star pupils, chefs Devan Cunningham and Justin Jacobs.
Chef Scott Conant makes a deal with "Shark Tank's" Lori Greiner and pulls a hostile takeover of Bobby Flay's kitchen to make chefs Derrell Smith or Chris Arellanes the boss.
